rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a current trend, including the trend aspect of clothing fashion.

example.english: Fashion changes so quickly these days that I can't keep up.
example.traditional: 而家潮流變得太快，我追唔切。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ciu4 lau4 bin3 dak1 taai3 faai3 ngo5 zeoi1 m4 cit3

rows.note: Use this for fashion as clothing or clothing styles rather than for a general trend.

example.english: I want to buy some minimalist fashion.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 gaan2 joek3 si4 zong1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the fashion industry or fashion world.

example.english: They are always discussing new trends in the fashion industry.
example.traditional: 佢哋成日討論時裝界嘅新趨勢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 tou2 leon6 si4 zong1 gaai3 ge3 san1 ceoi1 sai3

rows.note: Use this for the manner or way in which something is done.

example.english: I don't like this fashion of doing things.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5 ni1 zung2 zou6 faat3
